description.value:
Associate Project Planner – Pharmaceutical R&D / Drug Development
(PM I)
Location: North Chicago (Hybrid – Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday Onsite)
Contract Type: 6-month contract to start (W-2)
Industry: Pharmaceutical / Biotechnology
Location Requirement: Local candidates only – relocation is not being considered
Experience: 4+ years with a Bachelor's degree or 2+ years with a Master's degree
$44-$49/hr based on benefit selections
 
Orion Group is seeking an experienced Associate Project Planner to support a leading global pharmaceutical organization in Lake County, IL.

This position will play a critical role in supporting pharmaceutical research and development (R&D), drug development planning, and project execution across complex Asset Development Teams (ADTs).

The Associate Project Planner will be responsible for developing, maintaining, and analyzing integrated drug development project plans using Planisware (AMP), Microsoft Project, and standardized project management methodologies. This individual will work closely with Project Managers, functional leaders, and Directors to manage project timelines, analyze critical paths, identify risks and dependencies, and ensure accurate project data to support strategic decision-making across the R&D portfolio.

The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of pharmaceutical development processes, critical path analysis, project scheduling, and cross-functional collaboration within a matrixed organization.

Key Responsibilities

Project Planning & Scheduling
  • Develop, maintain, and optimize integrated project plans for complex pharmaceutical drug development programs, including late-stage development, partnered programs, and drug-device combination projects.
  • Utilize Planisware (AMP), Microsoft Project, and other project planning systems to manage schedules, milestones, dependencies, and deliverables.
  • Perform detailed micro- and macro-level critical path analysis to identify schedule risks, dependencies, and opportunities for timeline optimization.
  • Develop multiple project planning scenarios to support decision-making and evaluate potential impacts on drug development timelines.
  • Partner with Project Managers and functional teams to ensure project plans reflect accurate resource estimates, milestones, and development activities.
  • Support monthly project plan maintenance, timeline updates, and change request documentation.
Risk Management & Project Analysis
  • Identify, monitor, and analyze project risks, scheduling conflicts, and potential delays.
  • Conduct root cause analyses and recommend corrective actions to Project Managers, Managers, and Directors.
  • Assess project performance against established plans, timelines, and objectives.
  • Evaluate the impact of project changes on schedules, resources, critical paths, and overall program execution.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve project planning processes and operational efficiency.
Cross-Functional Collaboration & Communication
  • Collaborate with Asset Development Teams (ADTs), Project Managers, functional leaders, and senior management across pharmaceutical R&D.
  • Facilitate project communications, including meeting documentation, action item tracking, project updates, and team materials.
  • Coordinate activities across multiple functional groups in a matrixed environment to maintain alignment on project goals and timelines.
  • Prepare and communicate project planning updates, scheduling analyses, and recommendations to Managers and Directors.
  • Maintain project documentation, SharePoint sites, and other collaboration platforms.
Reporting, Data Management & Quality Control
  • Generate monthly and ad hoc project reports, dashboards, timelines, and portfolio planning analyses.
  • Review project data for accuracy, completeness, and consistency before reporting.
  • Utilize quality control (QC) reports to identify and resolve data discrepancies within project planning systems.
  • Collect, analyze, and interpret project metrics to support planning decisions and continuous improvement.
  • Develop standardized project planning guidelines, checklists, and reporting processes.
  • Ensure appropriate handling of confidential and sensitive project information.
Process Improvement & Project Management Support
  • Identify and implement improvements to project planning methodologies, systems, and departmental workflows.
  • Independently manage process improvement initiatives and coordinate activities to achieve defined objectives.
  • Provide training, administrative support, and guidance on project management tools, processes, and best practices.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives that enhance project planning accuracy, efficiency, and reporting capabilities.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in a scientific, technical, business, or project management-related discipline with 4+ years of relevant professional experience; OR a Master's degree with 2+ years of experience; OR a relevant Doctorate degree.
  • Experience in project planning, project management, scheduling, or portfolio planning, preferably within pharmaceutical or biotechnology R&D.
  • Hands-on experience with Planisware (AMP) and/or Microsoft Project for integrated project planning and scheduling.
  • Strong understanding of critical path methodology (CPM), including micro- and macro-level critical path analysis.
  • Knowledge of pharmaceutical drug development processes, milestones, dependencies, and development timelines.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop, maintain, and analyze complex project plans.
  • Experience identifying project risks, conducting schedule analyses, and recommending corrective actions.
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and competing priorities.
  • Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills within a matrixed organization.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and SharePoint.
  • Self-directed, detail-oriented, and capable of working independently while maintaining strong cross-functional relationships.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Direct experience with Planisware / AMP in pharmaceutical R&D or drug development planning.
  • Experience supporting Asset Development Teams (ADTs) or cross-functional drug development programs.
  • Experience planning late-stage clinical development programs, partnered development projects, or drug-device combination programs.
  • Advanced experience with integrated project scheduling, scenario planning, resource forecasting, and schedule risk analysis.
  • Familiarity with pharmaceutical R&D portfolio management and reporting.
  • Experience with QlikView, Spotfire, or similar business intelligence and reporting tools.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP), Lean Six Sigma, or comparable project management/process improvement certification.
  • Experience developing project management standards, templates, and process improvements.
Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is an experienced Pharmaceutical R&D Project Planner, Drug Development Project Scheduler, or Project Management Professional with hands-on expertise in integrated project planning and critical path analysis.

This individual understands the complexities of drug development, can navigate detailed project schedules, and is comfortable collaborating with Project Managers, scientists, functional leaders, and Directors.

Success in this role requires strong technical scheduling capabilities, pharmaceutical development knowledge, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to proactively identify risks and maintain accurate, decision-ready project plans.

description.value:
Eye Care Program Manager – Pharmaceutical Manufacturing
(Program Manager III) 

Location: Lake County, IL
Contract Duration: 12 Months to start
Employment Type: W-2 Contract
Industry: Pharmaceutical / Biotechnology
Experience Required: 8–10 Years in Project / Program Management

$70-$74/hr based on benefit selections

 
Orion Group is seeking an experienced Eye Care Program Manager to support a leading global pharmaceutical organization in Lake County, IL.

This position will be responsible for leading and coordinating complex, cross-functional programs within a highly regulated pharmaceutical manufacturing environment. The Program Manager will oversee integrated project planning, execution, stakeholder alignment, risk management, and operational priorities to ensure programs are delivered successfully and aligned with business objectives.

The ideal candidate brings a strong background in project and program management, pharmaceutical manufacturing or technical operations, and cross-functional leadership, with the ability to manage competing priorities, influence stakeholders, and communicate effectively with senior leadership.

Key Responsibilities

Program & Project Management
  • Lead the planning, coordination, and execution of complex programs involving multiple projects and workstreams.
  • Develop and maintain integrated project plans, work breakdown structures (WBS), schedules, milestones, critical paths, resource plans, and deliverables.
  • Monitor project progress, identify dependencies, and proactively address potential schedule or resource constraints.
  • Manage multiple concurrent initiatives while ensuring alignment with overall program objectives and business priorities.
  • Establish and maintain project governance, reporting structures, and performance tracking mechanisms.
 
 
Cross-Functional Leadership & Stakeholder Management
  • Coordinate activities across Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Supply Chain, Technical Operations, Engineering, Manufacturing, Packaging, Finance, and other business functions.
  • Lead and influence cross-functional teams within a matrixed organization, including stakeholders without direct reporting relationships.
  • Facilitate project meetings, drive accountability, and ensure timely resolution of issues and decisions.
  • Maintain strong relationships with technical, operational, and business stakeholders.
  • Prepare and deliver clear, concise project updates, presentations, and recommendations to senior leadership.
Risk Management & Change Control
  • Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate project risks, issues, and dependencies.
  • Develop contingency plans and corrective actions to minimize disruptions to project timelines and deliverables.
  • Manage changes to project scope, schedules, resources, assumptions, and priorities.
  • Evaluate the impact of proposed changes and maintain alignment among affected stakeholders.
  • Escalate critical issues appropriately and support timely decision-making.
Financial & Operational Management
  • Support project budgeting, resource allocation, financial tracking, and cost management.
  • Balance technical requirements, operational constraints, financial considerations, and business objectives.
  • Identify opportunities to improve project execution, operational efficiency, and resource utilization.
  • Collaborate with Finance and operational leadership to monitor project costs and business performance.
Project Tools, Reporting & Communication
  • Utilize Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, or comparable project management tools to develop schedules and track deliverables.
  • Maintain project documentation, dashboards, status reports, and executive presentations.
  • Leverage Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, SharePoint, and other collaboration tools to support program execution.
  • Ensure timely, accurate, and transparent communication across project teams and leadership.
Required Qualifications
  • 8–10 years of project or program management experience, preferably supporting complex technical, manufacturing, or operational initiatives.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and managing integrated project plans, schedules, milestones, dependencies, and resource requirements.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence cross-functional teams in a matrixed environment.
  • Proven ability to identify and mitigate risks, resolve project issues, and manage competing priorities.
  • Experience managing scope changes, project timelines, resource adjustments, and shifting business requirements.
  • Proficiency with project management tools such as Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, or equivalent systems.
  • Strong organizational, analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting project updates to senior leadership.
  • Ability to balance technical, operational, financial, and business considerations while driving successful program outcomes.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, or other regulated manufacturing environments.
  • 8+ years of related experience involving plant operations, manufacturing, technical operations, or engineering programs.
  • Educational background in Engineering, Chemistry, Industrial Pharmacy, or a related technical discipline.
  • Experience coordinating initiatives across Quality, Regulatory, Engineering, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Packaging.
  • Strong financial and business acumen, including project budgeting, project accounting, cost accounting, and resource forecasting.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Loop, SharePoint, Copilot, and other collaborative productivity tools.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or comparable project management training is a plus.
Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a seasoned Project or Program Manager who has successfully led complex, cross-functional initiatives in a pharmaceutical manufacturing, technical operations, or similarly regulated environment.

This individual is highly organized, proactive, and comfortable working with technical teams and senior business leaders. They can independently develop integrated project plans, manage risks and dependencies, navigate changing priorities, and drive accountability across multiple functions.

Success in this role requires strong execution skills, effective stakeholder leadership, sound business judgment, and the ability to keep complex programs moving forward in a fast-paced, matrixed organization.

Clinical Medical Services Specialist III - Clinical and Postmarketing Adverse Event Case Processing
Location: 100% remote. Candidates must be located in the US and able to work without visa sponsorship.
Length of Assignment: 1 year (extension based on performance and business need)
Pay Rate: $38-45/hr (depending on candidate location and medical benefit election)


Job Description

The Clinical Medical Services Specialist III collects, assesses, and processes clinical and postmarketing adverse event information in a compliant and timely manner. The role supports adherence to global regulations and company standards for quality, compliance, and productivity in adverse event management.

Responsibilities
  • Collect, assess, and process adverse event information from clinical and postmarketing sources within applicable timelines and in compliance with global regulatory requirements.
  • Perform seriousness assessments, labeling assessments, causality determinations, and initial and follow-up evaluations.
  • Adhere to company standards for case-processing quality, compliance, and productivity.
  • Maintain current knowledge and skills required for effective case processing.
Qualifications
  • Pharmaceutical industry experience with clinical case processing is required.
  • Two to four years of clinical experience, or two to three years of clinical experience combined with one year of pharmacovigilance experience.
  • Proficiency in case-processing processes, procedures, and conventions.
  • Bachelor's degree with a related health sciences background, such as RN, BSN, BS, or BS Pharm. Candidates without the specified degree may be considered if they have previous pharmaceutical experience.
  • Familiarity with relevant industry regulations and guidance, including ICH, FDA, EMEA, and MHRA requirements.
  • Veeva experience is beneficial but is not required.
